query:
UPDATE calendar_sources
            SET refresh_token_enc = COALESCE($3, refresh_token_enc),
                access_token_enc = $4,
                access_token_expires_at = $5,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = $1
              AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM calendar_sync_states st
                WHERE st.source_id = $1 AND st.locked_by = $2
              )
